package.description: Compare economic lifecycles of different designs.

en-US.description: Compare economic lifecycles of different designs.
en-US.longDescription: The Engineering Economic Analysis (EEA) program compares the lifecycle economics of alternative designs for HVAC systems and buildings. While primarily intended for HVAC building applications, the program can be used for other types of economic studies as well.
en-US.name: Engineering Economic Analysis

zh-CN.description: 比较不同设计的经济生命周期
zh-CN.longDescription: 工程经济分析（EEA）程序用于对比暖通空调系统及建筑替代设计方案的生命周期经济性。该程序虽主要针对暖通空调建筑应用开发，但同样适用于其他类型的经济性研究。
